items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: He was playing with us when... ...watched the blood together on Clownet. And Red Happy with him. ... Happy Cesar Martin, play loud.

ctx.x: What about Red Happy? He wasn't talking about Red Happy.

You remember Red Happy? Yeah. You remember Red Happy? He died in Chicago too didn't he? He was playing with us when... ...watched the blood together on Clownet. And Red Happy with him. He was terrible. Good drummer but... ...we'll be sure you know, like his soft music. Happy, how are you? Happy Cesar Martin, play loud. He quit sometimes, you know. He was terrible. I've been playing music around there when we were a kid. Great happy. You know, Black Happy, don't you? What's the good of the matter with him? What's…
Tell him he's with the Eureka Band still.
